chunks: What Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Muḥammad ibn Isḥāq and Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from one whom he mentioned, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
It suffices you, when you are with them, to recite like the speech of the النفس within oneself.
ai.seo_question: What kind of recitation is sufficient when praying behind someone who is not to be followed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about recitation in prayer behind one whose leadership is not to be followed. It states that a subdued, internal mode of recitation—like self-talk within oneself—is sufficient in that circumstance.
